definitions.explanation: A vertical section of a newspaper, magazine, or webpage.
A designated space on a form for entering information.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}のスポーツ{欄|らん}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: Read the sports section of the newspaper.

examples.japanese: {住所|じゅうしょ}{欄|らん}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the address field.

examples.japanese: コメント{欄|らん}に{意見|いけん}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote my opinion in the comments section.

notes:
{欄|らん} refers to designated sections or columns, whether in print media or on forms.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {住所|じゅうしょ}{欄|らん} (address field)
- {氏名|しめい}{欄|らん} (name field)
- {備考|びこう}{欄|らん} (remarks column)
- コメント{欄|らん} (comments section)
- {記入|きにゅう}{欄|らん} (entry field)
- {投書|とうしょ}{欄|らん} (letters to the editor column)
